subject.title: [Bug] Gateway swallows user-visible reply when an agent's exec stdout matches "configuration file" — replies=2 puts ⚠️ 🛠️ first, the actual reply second

question: Should successful Feishu turns suppress or demote retained mutating-tool warning finals, and should the immediate repair target the false exec `lastToolError` source, Feishu warning ordering, or a shared warning policy?
rationale: Source inspection can show the current warning and Feishu composition paths, but cannot choose the safety contract for unresolved mutating failures versus confusing post-success warnings.

options.title: Define narrow warning policy first
options.body: Keep this issue open and require a shared policy that preserves real unresolved mutating failures while suppressing or demoting false or recovered warnings in Feishu.

options.title: Fix exec classification first
options.body: Treat this as a narrower source bug and land a focused repair for the read-only or successful exec path before changing Feishu delivery behavior.

options.title: Centralize under broader Feishu leaks
options.body: Move the remaining policy discussion to #89247 or #39406 only if maintainers intentionally want this exact Feishu ordering report closed as subsumed.

recommendation.title: Define narrow warning policy first
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and require a shared policy that preserves real unresolved mutating failures while suppressing or demoting false or recovered warnings in Feishu.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the most recent merged Feishu final/error composition work directly adjacent to this symptom.
